page_title: PSG 1-1 REN | PSG v Rennes 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Goncalo Ramos (PSG) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Steve Mandanda no chance!
90+7' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is going to take the penalty!
90+6' A yellow card for a tackle by Steve Mandanda (Rennes). Bastien Dechepy doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+6' The PSG players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

90+5' Play continues despite the shouts by some PSG players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Bastien Dechepy interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+4' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+4' The main referee, Bastien Dechepy, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+2' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Bastien Dechepy ignores the protests.
90+1' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The foul by Fabian Ruiz (PSG) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Bastien Dechepy.
87' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Bastien Dechepy's book.
86' Referee Bastien Dechepy signals NO PENALTY for PSG after a VAR review!
86' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for PSG! Let's see what he decides.
85' PENALTY APPEAL after Goncalo Ramos (PSG) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
84' Marco Asensio (PSG) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Steve Mandanda intercepts the ball.
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Amine Gouiri will be replaced by Warmed Omari (Rennes).
80' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul.

76' Danilo Pereira (PSG) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
76' Vitinha (PSG) steps up to send the ball in.
74' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
71' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nuno Mendes (PSG) replacing Lucas Hernandez.
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ousmane Dembele as he is replaced by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
70' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.

69' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.

67' Marco Asensio (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
66' Substitution. Ibrahim Salah walks off the pitch and Martin Terrier (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
66' The game has come to an end for Arnaud Kalimuendo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Adrien Truffert (Rennes).
65' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Bradley Barcola will be replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
65' Here comes a substitution. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Kylian Mbappe.
64' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
63' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
59' Marco Asensio (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

59' Great save! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the top left corner was brilliantly saved by Steve Mandanda. PSG will take a corner kick.
57' That's a well-taken pass by Ousmane Dembele (PSG). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
56' It will be a substitution. Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is ready to enter the pitch as Desire Doue walks off.
54' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
52' Bastien Dechepy couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Desire Doue (Rennes) and blew his whistle.
49' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) strikes the ball harmlessly from a long-range free kick and it goes high over the bar. It's not easy to score from a distance like that.
48' The referee shows the yellow card to Desire Doue (Rennes).
47' A long pass, executed by Bradley Barcola (PSG), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
46' That will be all from Kang-In Lee who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marco Asensio (PSG).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Bradley Barcola (PSG) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
43' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
40' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and it's Kylian Mbappe (PSG) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
37' Flag goes up against Fabian Ruiz (PSG) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
36' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
33' 0 - 1 Amine Gouiri (Rennes) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Gianluigi Donnarumma with a strike into the top right corner. He makes it 0:1.
28' A pass into the penalty area from Kylian Mbappe (PSG) is intercepted by the defence.
28' The game is interrupted. Ludovic Blas (Rennes) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
26' 4:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
23' Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight and sees a foul from Guela Doue (Rennes).
21' Wasted opportunity! Achraf Hakimi (PSG) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
21' A quickly taken corner by PSG.

20' A pass into the box finds Vitinha (PSG) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Steve Mandanda denies him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
19' Vitinha (PSG) commits a rough foul. Bastien Dechepy stops the game and makes a call.
16' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
14' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance.
10' Bradley Barcola (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' The game is interrupted as Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is flagged offside.
3' PSG are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy will supervise the game today.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
